cl.x: Provide Sika® Colma Cleaner where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.04).
Sika® Colma Cleaner is a grease-free solvent specially formulated for the pre-cleaning of bond faces and the cleaning of tools and equipment.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Sika® Colma Cleaner is designed for cleaning surfaces prior to bonding and for cleaning of tools and equipment such as light metals and alloys, steel and stainless steel.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

s: Consumption: 50 ml/m² approx.
Flash-off time: Minimum 15 minutes; Maximum 8 hours

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
s: Soak a clean rag or lint-free paper towel in Sika® Colma Cleaner and clean the bonding areas to remove surface contamination. Tightly reseal the container immediately after each use.
After a flash-off time of 15 minutes apply the appropriate Primer or Aktivator and respect relevant flash-off times again.

cl.x: Sika® Colma Cleaner shall not be used on porous substrates.
